title: Turtle Beach Will Be In Attendance For The 30th Annual ROTH Conference On March 13, 2018
htmlContent:
[caption id="attachment_201564" align="aligncenter" width="640"] Photo Credit - Turtle Beach[/caption] Turtle Beach Corporation A driving gaming headset and the sound extra company has been welcomed to go to the 30th Yearly ROTH Capital Accomplices Conference. The conference is being held Walk 11-14, 2018 at The Ritz-Carlton in Dana Point, California.  
Turtle Beach management will hold one-on-one meetings with investors on Tuesday, March 13.
For more information about the conference or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with Turtle Beach management, please contact your ROTH representative or the company's investor relations team at 949-574-3860.
  About Turtle Beach Corporation Turtle Beach (www.turtlebeach.com) has been revolutionizing console multiplayer gaming since the very beginning with its wide selection of industry-leading, award-winning gaming headsets. Whether you're a professional esports athlete, hardcore gamer, casual player, or just starting out, Turtle Beach has the gaming headset to help you truly master your skills. Innovative and advanced technology, amazing audio quality, clear communication, lightweight and comfortable designs, and ease-of-use are just a few features that have made Turtle Beach a fan-favorite brand for gamers the world over. Made for Xbox and PlayStation® consoles as well as for PC, Mac®, and mobile/tablet devices, having a Turtle Beach gaming headset in your arsenal gives you the competitive advantage. The Company's shares are traded on the NASDAQ Exchange under the symbol: HEAR.   SOURCE Turtle Beach Corporation
